Return Manhattan distance from the origin using horizontal and vertical coordinates.
Arguments: horizontal, vertical.
Respond with exactly one JSON object with a string field "expression". No Markdown, prose or function definition. Use only numeric arithmetic, comparisons, lists, indexing/slicing, one-generator list comprehensions, conditional expressions and calls sum,min,max,len,abs,range. No attributes, imports or arbitrary calls.
